about: Jeffrey Owen Anderson is an attorney providing legal services covering Family Law.

Jeffrey Anderson, who practices law in Frisco, Texas, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2003 - 2026. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, he studied at Southern Methodist University Dedman School of Law. He graduated in 1994. After passing the bar exam, he was admitted to legal practice in 1994.
